exact_statement: For all rational parent masses p0,p1 and nonnegative rational child squares a,b with p0+p1=(a+b)/2, the kernel k(a,b)=a/(a+b) off zero rows and 1/2 on zero rows satisfies (p0+p1)k(a,b)=a/2 and k(a,b)+k(b,a)=1. These local statements are Lean-kernel checked. For every integer r>=1, f_r(x)=product_(j=0..r-1)(1-2x_(2j)x_(2j+1)) on the uniform 2r-bit cube, with the prescribed essential pair-first computing tree, has H(f_r)=2r, I(f_r)=r, terminal residual spectral label E=empty, H(Pi|S0)=r/2 and H(Pi|E)=3r/2 under the retained-root coherent coupling. Consequently C_root=H(Pi|Y)-H(Pi|S0)=r-h2((1-2^-r)/2), C_reset=H(Pi|Y)-H(Pi|E)=-h2((1-2^-r)/2), and C_root-C_reset=r; sum_v w_v J_v=r. The all-r entropy claim is analytic, with separate exact finite certificates, not a Lean entropy theorem. Replacing root conditioning by terminal-only conditioning cannot be a free bank conversion; an influence-priced reset bound needs coefficient at least 1 (or 1/2 for its half-bank). This does not refute A092 retained-root conversion or FEI.

exact_statement: For every uniform-cube Boolean sign and finite deterministic fresh-singleton stopping tree, on its actual coherent root lift let S be the root Fourier-square sample, Q the final queried set, W=S\Q, D=S intersect Q, and A any fixed superset of all possibly queried coordinates. With a=I_A(f) and R=I(f)-E I(f_leaf), the injected information is e=I(W;Pi|S)=H(D|S), E|D|=R, a-R=E I_A(f_leaf), and e<=a h2(R/a). The bound is the cross-entropy of ONE normalized conditional reference rho_theta(d|S)=theta^|d|(1-theta)^(|S intersect A|-|d|), theta=R/a, minus its conditional KL. Root-Markov compatibility of the actual W is equivalent to e=0. Every leaf independent of A implies e=0 despite variable query sets; E I_A(f_leaf)<=kappa R implies e<=(1+kappa)h2(1/(1+kappa))R. With output information o and Gamma_W=H(Pi|Y)-H(Pi|W), one has o/2+[Gamma_W]_+/2<=R/ln(2)+e/2. The coefficient one in the active entropy capacity is asymptotically sharp on A048's actual indexed-parity point-defect family with k=2r+2. Arbitrary overlapping or identical terminal data cores are permitted when all controller dependence is resolved. Terminal Fourier entropy and influence remain retained; no universal history-bank supply or FEI conclusion is proved.
